owner_discovery_rule: owner_files is the machine-authoritative active Second Shift lane set. Controllers, workers, handoffs and enforcement enumerate it rather than compile fixed lane names.
system_lane_rule: First-class peer systems receive their own owner lane. DOCUMENTS is a first-class peer and therefore has DOCUMENTS-DELEGATIONS.json. PROSE is retired and is not an active lane. Product-root capability portfolios do not automatically become lanes unless architecture authority makes them first-class systems.

SYSTEM_MASTER.reason: The temporary root owner lane was introduced while Documents was incorrectly modeled as a non-system portfolio. It is removed from active scheduling; product-root governance remains the portfolio controller rather than a peer worker lane.

p9_selector_reconciliation.history_rule: P9 remains historical evidence. The 2026-09-10 Documents/Prose architecture transition does not rewrite P9; current scheduling follows this registry owner_files set.

portfolio_rule: The portfolio controller reads every active owner file declared by owner_files from current authority, revalidates each against its control binding and current obligation registry, removes stale/non-open items from admission, and selects dependency-valid work. Retired lanes are never scheduled.
day_shift_rule: Whenever an active system owner chat closes, supersedes, blocks or materially changes its current objective, it reconciles its registry-declared delegation file in the same working session. Documents follows the same rule as Core, Learning and Book.
night_start_rule: The portfolio controller performs fresh pre-shift reconciliation and every active owner worker independently revalidates immediately before execution.
dispatch_rule: Every active registry-declared lane is eligible for the configured owner-worker cadence during 00:00-07:00. Implementations derive active lanes from owner_files; retired_lanes are evidence only.
claim_rule: Only one mutation-capable claim/lease may be live per active owner lane.
retry_rule: Transient dependencies receive a finite classified retry budget; after exhaustion the lane switches to independent safe work when available.
stale_rule: No job survives a control-binding mismatch by default. Preserve evidence/checkpoint, re-evaluate, then create a new/revalidated delegation bound to current authority.
no_work_rule: An active lane may be idle only after a durable all-eight-rungs-exhausted proof. A retired lane is not idle; it is out of the active scheduling set.
successor_rule: After every completion or material block, the active owner worker re-reads live authority and selects the next dependency-valid unattended-safe project while time remains.
utilization_rule: Per-lane append-only shift event ledgers are authoritative for active lanes only. Historical Prose/root ledgers remain evidence and are not expected after retirement.
